# mastersportal.com API

Search and browse scholarships from Mastersportal.com, with optional filters for destination country and academic discipline.

## Install / import

```python
from parse_apis.mastersportal_com_api import Mastersportal
```

## Operations

Call these on the client's collection accessors (e.g. `client.<collection>.<op>(…)`) or via active-record navigation on returned objects — see [`example.py`](./example.py) for the exact call spelling. List operations return a lazy `Paginator`.

| Call | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `client.scholarships.search(discipline_id: Optional[str] = None, destination_country: Optional[str] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None, max_fetches: int = 1000)` | `Paginator[Scholarship]` | Search scholarships available on Mastersportal. Results are auto-iterated across pages. Supports filtering by destination country (ISO 2-letter code) and discipline ID. Returns scholarship title, description, provider, deadline, grant details, and a direct URL. Pagination is handled by the returned iterator; page/cursor parameters are not exposed. |

## Errors

| Error | Raised when | Carries |
|---|---|---|
| `ScholarshipSearchError` | Invalid input parameters provided | — |

Runtime errors (`RateLimitError`, `UpstreamError`, `PaginationLimitError`, …) are importable from `parse_apis` and can occur on any call.
